name: JK Trouble Main"s
source:
Haruto is the heir to the wealthiest household in the world, but he’s still only a student spending happy-go-lucky days at Amagi Gakuen. Then one day, he fell in love with his classmate Hisa. He sought advice from his classmate and secretly maid Emi, who began to investigate Hisa to know her nature better.

Then, Emi heard an awful moan and found her respected master passed out on the ground in a strange position. Next to him was a crying frightened Hisa. Emi was completely dumbfounded at the turn of events.
Will Haruto's first love come true? Or rather, will they be able to salvage their past relationship?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
春人是世界最富有家族的继承人，却仍只是天城学园里过着悠闲日子的学生。某天，他爱上了同班同学久纱。于是，他向同学兼秘密女仆艾米寻求建议，让她调查久纱以了解她的性格。

后来，艾米听见可怕的呻吟声，发现敬爱的主人以奇怪姿势昏倒在地，旁边还有哭泣、受惊的久纱。面对事态突变，艾米彻底目瞪口呆。春人的初恋能实现吗？或者，他们能挽回过去的关系吗？

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
